body:
## Summary

The `documents` profile leaves three kinds of personal data unchanged unless a label precedes them: street addresses, school acronyms, and personal profile URLs.

## Reproduction (0.16.0)

```js
import { sanitize } from '@link-foundation/sensitive-data-sanitizer';
const text = (s) => sanitize(s, { profile: 'documents' }).text;
```

All values below are invented or public.

### Street addresses

| input | output |
|---|---|
| `Адрес: г. Казань, ул. Ленина, д. 5, кв. 12` | `Адрес: [REDACTED]` (correct) |
| `ул. Ленина, д. 5, кв. 12` | unchanged |
| `проживает по адресу ул. Ленина, 10` | unchanged |
| `улица Ленина, дом 10` | unchanged |

A house and flat number after a street marker (`ул.`, `улица`, `д.`, `дом`, `кв.`) looks like a structural signal that does not need a preceding `Адрес:` label.

### School acronyms

| input | output |
|---|---|
| `Московский государственный университет, 2012` | `[REDACTED], 2012` (correct) |
| `Образование: МГТУ им. Баумана` | unchanged |
| `окончил МГТУ им. Баумана в 2012` | unchanged |
| `окончил МГУ в 2012 году` | unchanged |

The full name is detected and the acronym is not, even directly after the `Образование:` label. Those acronyms and the school they name are public, but together with a person they are part of a personal profile, as a full school name is.

### Personal profile URLs

| input | output |
|---|---|
| `профиль: https://www.linkedin.com/in/ivan-petrov-12345` | unchanged |
| `https://github.com/ivan-petrov91` | unchanged |
| `https://vk.com/ivan.petrov91` | unchanged |

The path of such a URL identifies one person directly.

## Expected

These forms are replaced in the `documents` profile, or `docs/COVERAGE.md` lists them as known limits.

## Acceptance

- Each unchanged row above is replaced, or documented as a limit.
- Addresses of public places in ordinary prose and URLs without a personal path (`https://github.com/`) stay unchanged.
